title: Closed vs. Open Rhinoplasty: Know Your Options

html:
Rhinoplasty is a treatment option for people seeking to enhance the appearance and function of their nose. A slight change in your nose appearance can significantly boost your self-image and breathing. Therefore, it is critical to get treatment from reputable, experienced and highly qualified plastic surgeon, like Dr. Michael Hanemann at Hanemann Plastic Surgery in Baton Rouge.
Benefits of Rhinoplasty
When done right, rhinoplasty treatment can:
• Make your nose smaller, larger, narrower or wider.
• Change the angle or shape of your nose tip.
• Repair a crooked nose.
• Improve your breathing.
• Fix various cosmetic problems.
• Eliminate a bump in your nose.
Generally, there are two main categories of rhinoplasty surgery: closed (endonasal) and open (external). Since each surgical approach is unique, our plastic surgeon will discuss your options and help you choose the best.
Closed vs. Open Rhinoplasty
Most people seeking to have a nose job usually know the changes they yearn for. As such, doctors can make the changes using a closed approach where they make incisions in your nostrils or via an open approach where they make incisions under your nose tip.
It’s critical to be well-informed about your options in order to make informed decisions. Let’s look at the two treatment options in detail.
Open Rhinoplasty
The open rhinoplasty treatment uses a small bridging incision to join the left and right nostril. During the surgery, your doctor folds the nasal skin to clearly access the lower nasal skeleton. Most people prefer open surgery nose jobs because of its effectiveness and accuracy. It has also transformed nasal cavity problems such as twisted noses, cleft-lip, and other severe deformities.
Most plastic surgeons recommend open rhinoplasty for changing complex nasal anatomies for its effectiveness, improved diagnostic accuracy and because it can make precision re-designing of deformed noses much easier.
Closed Rhinoplasty
With the closed treatment, your doctor positions the surgical incisions in your nostrils in a way that prevents the visibility of any part of the incision and scar. Since the left and right nostrils remain disconnected, it can be more difficult to re-position the nasal skin because of the narrow surgical openings.
Ideal Candidates for Rhinoplasty
You may be a suitable candidate for a nose job if you:
• Are unhappy or self-conscious of your nose
• Have a nose deformity
• Are the right age (above mid-teens)
• Are informed about the treatment and have real expectations
• Know any allergies and medical conditions, and are able to inform your surgeon.
If you’re ready for rhinoplasty treatment, visit Hanemann Plastic Surgery in Baton Rouge for your first consultation with our nose surgeon. Contact us today to book an appointment!
